title: Cryptool Launches Announcements, Messaging and Real-Time Notifications
content_html:
Cryptool Launches Announcements, Messaging and Real-Time Notifications

August 5, 2026

Cryptool has introduced a new set of communication features designed to keep users informed and connected across the platform.

The new Announcements feature provides a centralized place to view important updates, product releases, platform news, and organizational communications, ensuring users always have access to the latest information.

The new Messages feature enables secure communication between team members, investors, and stakeholders directly within Cryptool, making collaboration easier without relying on external messaging platforms.

To ensure users never miss an important event, Cryptool now delivers real-time notifications across the platform. Receive instant alerts for portfolio activity, investment updates, pool events, group activity, vesting schedules, project launches, and other key actions. Whether you're monitoring investments or managing multiple organizations, Cryptool keeps you informed the moment something important happens.

Together, these features create a more connected experience by bringing communication, collaboration, and notifications into a single platform, helping users stay up to date with every important event across their digital asset ecosystem.

These features are now available to all Cryptool users.
